authoring: Source-derived retrospective instrument. Candidate identity metadata inspected before freezing; any subsequent source-era expansion must be explicitly outcome-informed. No candidate PASS prose used to accept observations.
goal: Demonstrate source-required native engine capabilities at their actual historical source revision.

partialFacets.fileReadback: An independently captured successful native shell read of the source-specified run-specific smoke file returns the exact engine-specific required content prefix and a nonempty date suffix. A write invocation, output existence, agent prose or echoed expected content without a real read is insufficient.
partialFacets.fileWriteReadback: A successful native write to that same source-specified path precedes the independent read and agrees byte-for-byte with its captured content; unknown write custody does not erase a demonstrated readback.
partialFacets.build: Actual source-required make build invocation completes successfully with native output showing compilation/build work. An agent statement, success job or wrapper exit alone does not suffice.

nativeQuantity: Distinct independently verified source-defined capability facets per original run attempt, deduplicated within the attempt and assigned to disjoint seven-day periods by actual completion time.
sourceBinding: Preserve immutable exact-head Markdown, compiled workflow, imports, Git commit/tree/blob identities and original run/job/artifact receipts. Reject incompatible sources and deterministic command overrides that bypass the requested operation.
captureAuthority: Provider-native tool invocation/completion or protected host shell capture with arguments, actual returned bytes and completion identity. Console tool-shaped prose alone is not authority. Validate source/run/job/session custody and time ordering.
fullAcceptance: Preserve all original requirements, including exact native MCP operation, permitted tool identity, imports, source-specific build/runtime checks and safe outputs. Partial facets never establish full acceptance.
attribution: Native effects bound to the original workflow run establish attempt-level contribution only; not exclusive causation, repository improvement, current runtime certification or exhaustive historical coverage.
missing: Unknown is null, not zero. Inventory excludes Discussions/comments and cannot establish their absence. Failed/setup-only/expired observations retain explicit gaps and rejections.
decision: Not rated: no agreed native keep bar or matched cost evidence.
execution: Read-only bounded acquisition followed by deterministic offline collector/scorer/replay; no model calls, workflow dispatch, repository execution or mutation.
